summary: PRs are tested by Azure Pipelines, failures are posted as GitHub comments with the ansible-test commands to reproduce, and you can run those locally after sourcing hacking/env-setup.
questions: How do I reproduce a CI sanity failure from my PR locally?
Where do I see why my PR checks failed?

answer_card.title: Reproducing CI failures locally
answer_card.answer_md:
Azure Pipelines tests every PR and comments with failing tests, such as `ansible-test sanity --test pep8`. Reproduce locally:
```shell-session
source hacking/env-setup
ansible-test sanity --test pep8
ansible-test sanity --test validate-modules
```
If there's no comment, click **Details** under "checks have failed".
